From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, Apr 7, 2026 at 3:02 PM PDT
Subject: Post-call: Platform fit, stakeholders, and contracting path (Mexera Health)

Hi Lena & team,

Thanks again for a productive call today — appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned: 

Highlights from the discussion:
- Use case: 8-week pilot (inference for clinical summarization) with a focus on latency and private deployment options.
- Decision criteria called out by Ana (VP Product): latency under 200ms at 95th, on-prem/VPC support, and SOC2 controls.
- Security contact: Jin Soo Park (InfoSec) - requested SOC2 report and data handling detail.
- Procurement: procurement@mexerahealth.com (please see line-item below).

Stakeholder map (as I captured it):
- Economic buyer: Ana Morales, VP Product (final sign-off)
- Technical sponsor: Diego R. (Engineering Lead)
- Security/infosec: Jin Soo Park
- Procurement & legal: procurement@mexerahealth.com (Ravi Shah is primary contact)

Contracting / redline sequence I recommend:
1) NDA first (short fast turn) — protects pilot details and lets us share architecture.
2) DPA in parallel with NDA redline if they require it for data handling specifics.
3) MSA pilot appendix and token/pricing terms once scope is agreed.

Action items / asks:
- Lena / Ravi: please confirm procurement contact and usual internal turn times for NDA / MSA / DPA.
- Jin Soo: If possible, send any specific technical questions or checklist items we should answer during pilot scoping.
- Ben (cc): once we have procurement turn times I’d like you to propose a legal routing plan and expected SLAs on our side.
- Karthik: can you coordinate a brief technical Q&A between our infra team and Diego next week?

I attached a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP_proposal.pdf) and our standard short NDA (NDA_Redline_v1.docx) for their review. If procurement prefers DocuSign, happy to send the envelope.

Proposed timeline (tentative):
- NDA signed: target within 3 business days
- Pilot kickoff: within 1 week of NDA
- MSA/DPA in parallel with pilot negotiation; goal to finalize within 3 weeks

Thanks — I’ll hold on next steps once Ravi confirms procurement cadence.

Best,

Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Monica / Karthik — thanks for the heads up and the MAP. Quick response with our recommended SLAs and routing notes so you can share with Ravi: 

Redwood recommended turnaround (internal):
- NDA: 24 business hours for review + redline; 48 hours if escalated.
- DPA: 48-72 business hours to provide an initial redline (assuming standard processing scope).
- MSA (pilot appendix): 48-72 business hours for first-pass redline; subsequent rounds depend on customer counsel.

Routing / escalation guidance:
- If procurement returns only minor edits to the NDA, approve and execute via DocuSign within 48 hours.
- If the NDA contains >3 material commercial changes (term length, IP carve-outs, liability caps), escalate to Legal Ops and loop in external counsel.
- For DPA items that require architectural detail, loop Karthik + our infra lead for a short Q&A with Jin Soo — those technical clarifications speed the DPA review.

Attachments: I included a short checklist we use to triage vendor DPA requests (Checklist_DPA_triage.txt) to minimize back-and-forth.

I’ll draft an email template for the DocuSign envelope and the MAP-based ask to procurement that Monica can send to Ravi. Monica — once you send the NDA envelope, cc me and I’ll prioritize the review.

Ben Carter
Sales Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 510-555-0199
